question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

He would have preferred anger to her cold __________.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **indifference**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Indifference" **refers to an emotional state where a person shows no particular interest or concern towards something or someone. (उदासीनता)

 
 
• **Example: **She treated his feelings with cold indifference.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that anger over her cold indifference was what he would have chosen.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **indifference**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Differently **(अलग तरीके से): In a way that is not the same as another way.

 
 
• **Example:** She thinks differently from the rest of her team.
 
 
 
• **Difference **(अंतर): A point or way in which people or things are not the same.
 
 
• **Example: **The difference between the two products is quite noticeable.
 
 
 
• **Indifferent** (उदासीन): Having no particular interest or sympathy; unconcerned.
 
 
• **Example:** He was indifferent to the outcome of the game.
